title: The Sparrow's universal Time AI: one Breakwater afterburner-and-rocket drive for I1-I4, grown from both genomes
goal: Run by hand until Froglet Compute is back (Shombith paused it 2026-11-06; /mnt/project-files/regatta-training/local_run.py). The Sparrow's universal Time AI (Docs/AI_SYSTEM/AI_PLAN.md step time-arcade): ONE HoldBoostAIPolicySO drive (when to hold the afterburner, when to let go before a station, when to fire the rocket at its plug) that races all four Breakwater intensities well, grown from the two drives the game ships (SparrowAIBoostPolicy_Breakwater and the base SparrowAIBoostPolicy) and mutations of each, scored on Tools/Build/breakwater_sparrow_sim.py (mean + 0.5 x the worst intensity). The winner is the Sparrow Regatta is searched against (step time-arena-course); the base drive's 0.6 s afterburner stutter is why the AI Sparrow is Regatta's slowest hull (Tools/Build/sparrow_regatta_sim.py).
asked_by: Garrett 2026-11-06 (the Regatta balance plan's Phase A: train every AI in its own Time game before any course search; brief 4 of the plan thread)
promote: A PROPOSAL for the AI owner (Yash), any of the core four approving: race the best against both shipped genomes on 8 FRESH courses per intensity (seedbase 99000); keep it only if it finishes every race and its composite is lower. Then it becomes the drive the Sparrow flies in every mode (the base SparrowAIBoostPolicy, and SparrowAIBoostPolicy_Breakwater retires or takes the same numbers - Yash's call), written with the learner's asset writer (Tools/Build/learn_drives_from_flights.py), never by hand. Editor checks go in Docs/UNITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md: Breakwater at I1-I4, and Regatta's I1 benchmark (the Sparrow raced alone, against its 117-150 s of 2026-11-03).
